> 이 호는 **초안 모드**입니다. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 를 설정하면 아래 후보에서 사건을 골라 이야기로 편집하고, 뉴스는 전선별 요약으로 압축됩니다.

## [일일전쟁사]

_후보 사건:_

- **1302** — Frederick III of Aragon and Charles, Count of Valois sign the Peace of Caltabellotta, which ends the War of the Sicilian Vespers and divides the old Kingdom of Sicily into an island portion and a peninsular portion. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_III_of_Sicily))
- **1795** — War of the First Coalition: The British capture Trincomalee (present-day Sri Lanka) from the Dutch in order to keep it out of French hands. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/War_of_the_First_Coalition))
- **1813** — Peninsular War: Spanish troops repel a French attack in the Battle of San Marcial. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peninsular_War))
- **1864** — American Civil War: The Battle of Jonesborough, the culmination of the Atlanta campaign, begins as Union forces under General William T. Sherman clash with Confederate troops under General William J. Hardee south of Atlanta. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Civil_War))
- **1918** — World War I: Start of the Battle of Mont Saint-Quentin, a successful assault by the Australian Corps during the Hundred Days Offensive. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_War_I))
- **1920** — Polish–Soviet War: A decisive Polish victory in the Battle of Komarów. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polish%E2%80%93Soviet_War))
